strategy.primary: Fresh attackers every turn (hasty creatures, ninjutsu/sneak, attack-token makers) connect across several opponents so Goro-Goro makes a 5/5 flying Dragon per damaged player; the Dragon army wins in the air.
strategy.secondary: Breath of Fury extra-combat loops (with Goro-Goro, Urabrask's Forge, Daring Piracy, Determined Iteration or Loyal Apprentice), extra combats (Karlach, Great Train Heist, Aggravated Assault) and Dragon damage (Terror of the Peaks, Dragon Tempest).

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Goro-Goro and Satoru
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Whenever one or more creatures you control that entered this turn deal combat damage to a player, create a 5/5 red Dragon Spirit creature token with flying.
{1}{R}: Creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.

identity.why: 5/5 Dragon whenever fresh creatures connect; team haste.
Extra-combat engine with the commander's Dragons.
Continuous haste for Dragons made mid-loop.
